title: ExecutiveScreeningPut
description: Executive screening settings request object for updating call screening and alert preferences.

enabled.description: Set to enable or disable executive screening.

alertType.description:
* `SILENT` - No audible alert is provided for executive screening.
 * `RING_SPLASH` - A short ring (splash) is used as an alert for executive screening.

alertAnywhereLocationEnabled.description: Indicates if alerts are enabled for Single Number Reach locations.

alertMobilityLocationEnabled.description: Indicates if alerts are enabled for Webex Go locations.

alertSharedCallAppearanceLocationEnabled.description: Indicates if alerts are enabled for Shared Call Appearance locations.
